dataset: Adverse event (治療不良反應) controlled vocabulary
policy: Canonical adverse_event.* ids (D17). adverse_event.* records do not exist yet — this is the vocabulary and the gap map, same approach as symptom_taxonomy.json (D14 build order).
觀察到的不良反應是一筆觀察值，不是診斷：任何程式路徑都不得將 adverse_event.* 觀察自動轉為 TCM 證型或病名（D17 §6）。
疑似暴露（suspected）不得自動升級為確診（confirmed）——本檔案的不良反應同理，通報後的嚴重度分級一律由臨床人員在該次就診記錄中人工判定，不由此清單推論。
severity_scale below is the closed set every adverse_event.* case entry's severity field must use — mild | moderate | severe. This file defines the scale; it does not assign a severity to any record.
IDs are ASCII (D10). Adding an adverse event is a schema change: this file, then the intake/visit form, then any validator that checks adverse_event.* ids.
applies_to: Visit-level adverse event observations captured under a future adverse_event.* field
